zones.title: A lit clothes-storage console
zones.description: The dark three-drawer chest becomes the console: one selected FADO/KAJPLATS opal lamp on one side, The Sill Small Parlor Palm with Westcott Black pot opposite, and central useful top/tray space. Plant is tabletop, not floor-standing. Foliage/pot-height assumptions and exact placement require source-sized fit verification. White opal/lightgray repeat owned Honeywell/Aeron highlights.

zones.title: A calm visitor corner
zones.description: The Axvall gray-blue boucle visitor chair and quiet graphic Rift rug tie the cool walls together. Retain existing brick/fireplace and natural brown wicker cat tree. No floor plant is proposed.
